ideas.name: Apple Inc.
ideas.thesis: AAPL appeared in all 6 overnight screens, though conviction was split (1 high / 5 medium), reflecting genuine directional disagreement — itself a signal to use options rather than stock. The Sep 9 'Surprise and Shine' launch event produced a muted to negative stock reaction (-2.5% into event, minimal post-event bounce), following a historically strong 60-day post-launch recovery pattern seen in 17 of past cycles. Wide analyst dispersion — BofA Buy at $380 vs. Jefferies Sell with a lower target — and near-term gross margin compression guided to 47–48% argue for defined-risk options structures around the Sep 11–12 pre-order open and Oct 29 earnings.
